Attached: 1 image

PHP2Shell patching gap: tag drift. Once php:8.3-fpm is republished on 8.3.36, the tag points at a new digest, but pods started before the rebuild keep the old one.

Anchore's Kubernetes inventory agent tracks running workloads by digest, so joining it with a search for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 gives you a restart list.

Our latest blog: https://anchore.com/blog/php2shell-your-sboms-already-know-which-php-builds-youre-running/ 

#PHP2Shell #Kubernetes #SBOM
